newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian nurse murdered in Saudi Arabia-report.
newsitem.headline: Australian nurse murdered in Saudi Arabia-report.

text.p: An Australian nurse died in suspicious circumstances while working in a Saudi Arabian military hospital, a foreign affairs spokesman said on Sunday.
The spokesman said nurse Yvonne Gilford, 56, died on Friday. "I cannot confirm the manner in which she died, but certainly to say she died in suspicious circumstances," he said.
However, a Sydney newspaper said Gilford had been murdered.
The Sun-Herald newspaper said Gilford was suffocated, stabbed and bashed with a hammer and was found dead in the early hours of Friday in her room in the King Fahd Military Hospital in Dhahran.
Two years ago, a nurse from the Philippines was stabbed to death at the base, the newspaper said.
The newspaper said Gilford, who had been in Saudi Arabia for six months, was last seen alive leaving a Christmas party.
It said it had been contacted by 14 other Australian nurses at the Saudi hospital, claiming they had barricaded themselves in their rooms for fear the murderer would return.
"We want to go home," they told the newspaper.
An Australian consular official from the Saudi capital of Riyadh has been sent to Dhahran while Saudi authorities investigate Gilford's death.
